transcript.text: Good morning. Before I sign off on the final maintenance sequence and release instructions for M-12, V-8, and G-3, I need to hear from each of you. Per our standard board check-in, I need the maintenance chief, dispatcher, and supply NCO to report any changes from your sections. Are there any updates or issues I need to be aware of before we finalize the sequence for tomorrow's available maintenance bay?

M-12 should not be sequenced for routine service tomorrow — it needs brake repair first.
